description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the Savings Accounts external ID functionality within the Apache Fineract project. It tests creating, updating, approving, retrieving, undoing approval, deleting, and confirming deletion of savings accounts identified by external IDs.

classes.name: SavingsAccountsExternalIdTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing savings account operations via external IDs in the Fineract system.

methods.name: submitSavingsAccountsApplication
methods.description: Creates a new savings account application with a generated external ID.

methods.name: updateSavingsAccountWithExternalId
methods.description: Updates the savings account identified by the external ID.

methods.name: approveSavingsAccount
methods.description: Approves the savings account associated with the external ID.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsAccountWithExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves the savings account details by external ID and verifies its status.

methods.name: undoApprovalSavingsAccountWithExternalId
methods.description: Reverts the approval of the savings account identified by external ID.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsAccountWithExternalIdSecondTime
methods.description: Retrieves the savings account again to verify status after undoing approval.

methods.name: deleteSavingsAccountWithExternalId
methods.description: Deletes the savings account identified by external ID.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsAccountWithExternalIdThirdTime
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the deleted savings account, expecting a 404 error.
